24	\subsection{Detection Signal Across Model Families}
25	\label{sec:detection}
26	
27	Table~\ref{tab:cohens_d} presents Cohen's $d$ effect sizes for $\ell_z^*$ across three model families and two benchmarks.
28	All single-seed bootstrap CIs exclude zero, confirming that $\Delta\ell_z^*$ reliably separates contaminated from clean models at both contamination levels.
29	
30	On MMLU, effect sizes range from $|d|{=}2.30$ (Llama at 50\%) to $|d|{=}7.44$ (Qwen at 25\%), with Qwen at 5\% ($|d|{=}4.15$) confirming detection at the lowest contamination level tested. Llama ($|d|{=}2.57$/$2.80$/$2.56$/$2.30$) and Mistral ($|d|{=}3.83$/$3.37$/$4.09$) show comparable magnitudes.
31	On ARC-C (295 items), Qwen yields $|d|{=}3.16$ at 15\% and $|d|{=}5.30$ at 50\%, demonstrating that detection remains feasible even on small benchmarks when contamination is sufficiently concentrated.
32	
33	Clean-model $\ell_z^*$ baselines diverge substantially (Qwen ${+}8.68$, Llama ${+}0.26$, ARC-C ${-}5.42$; Appendix~\ref{app:baseline_meaning}), making absolute thresholds uninformative.
34	The $\Delta\ell_z^*$ design normalizes these divergent baselines (Figure~\ref{fig:heatmap}).
35	
36	\begin{figure}[t]
37	  \centering
38	  \includegraphics[width=\columnwidth]{fig_heatmap.pdf}
39	  \caption{Cohen's $|d|$ heatmap (values from Table~\ref{tab:cohens_d}; multi-seed means where available). Blue intensity reflects effect-size magnitude. Grey cells: not tested.}
40	  \label{fig:heatmap}
41	\end{figure}

43	\subsection{Model-Specific $\theta$-Shift Dynamics}
44	\label{sec:theta_dynamics}
45	
46	Contamination inflates $\hat{\theta}_{\text{MLE}}$, which ``explains away'' anomalous successes on hard items---we term this \emph{$\theta$-shift absorption}.
47	$\theta$-shift magnitude is comparable across families ($\Delta\theta{\approx}0.5$), yet fixed-$\theta$ amplification diverges markedly (Table~\ref{tab:theta_fixed}; Figure~\ref{fig:composite}c).
48	
49	$\theta$-shift absorption is the dominant source of detection variability for high-ability models at high contamination:
50	(i) fixed-$\theta$ estimation amplifies Qwen's multi-seed $|d|$ by 2.4$\times$ at 50\% ($5.08 \to 12.32$; Table~\ref{tab:theta_fixed}), while Llama shows no amplification ($0.4\times$);
51	(ii) $\theta$-anchoring reduces Qwen's inter-seed CV from 60\% to 19\%, confirming that training-run variance is driven by $\theta$-shift stochasticity rather than true signal variance;
52	(iii) the cross-model ranking under free-$\theta$ is seed-dependent at 50\%, making $\theta$-anchoring a necessary condition for reliable detection of high-ability models at high contamination.
53	
54	ARC-C reverses this pattern: despite 89.7\% baseline accuracy, contamination produces \emph{larger} effect sizes ($|d|{=}3.16$/$5.30$).
55	This ceiling effect arises because 295 items with high baseline accuracy leave minimal room for $\theta$ inflation; contamination manifests as anomalous successes on the few remaining hard items, producing disproportionately large $\ell_z^*$ shifts.
56	Detection sensitivity thus depends on the interaction between model ability and benchmark characteristics.
57	
58	\paragraph{Fixed-$\theta$ estimation.}
59	Table~\ref{tab:theta_fixed} compares free- and fixed-$\theta$ Cohen's $d$.
60	The amplification ratio tracks baseline $|\ell_z^*|$ monotonically: Qwen ($\ell_z^*{=}{+}8.68$) shows $2.4{\times}$ at 50\%, Mistral ($+4.02$) $1.7{\times}$, while Llama ($+0.26$) shows $0.4{\times}$ despite comparable $\theta$-shift ($\Delta\theta{=}0.52$).
61	Fixed-$\theta$ is thus a targeted remedy for models with substantial baseline misfit, not a universal one.
62

93	\subsection{Detection-Diagnosis Tradeoff}
94	\label{sec:degradation}
95	
96	Table~\ref{tab:degradation} compares three statistics: $\ell_z^*$ (4PL parameters), HT (difficulty only), and accuracy $z$-scores (no item parameters).
97	For pure detection, simpler statistics are more powerful: accuracy $z$-scores yield $|d|$ values up to an order of magnitude larger than person-fit statistics, because cross-seed accuracy variance is near-zero.
98	HT generally exceeds $\ell_z^*$, since HT is not attenuated by the Snijders correction.
99	
100	Yet the diagnostic power reverses.
101	$\ell_z^*$ uniquely supports (a)~\emph{seen/unseen decomposition}, though item-level detection is near-random (AUROC${\approx}0.53$; Appendix~\ref{app:item_auroc}); (b)~\emph{$\theta$-shift mechanism} (\S\ref{sec:theta_dynamics}); and (c)~\emph{structural sensitivity}: $\ell_z^*$ flags 57/60 leaderboard cells as aberrant (Figure~\ref{fig:leaderboard_heatmap}) vs.\ 4/60 for accuracy $z$-scores \citep{stonge2011}.
102	In practice, accuracy $z$-scores screen candidates; $\ell_z^*$ then characterizes whether the signal reflects $\theta$-shift absorption or direct memorization.
103	Within the IRT family, 4PL gains $+$27.3pp power over 3PL on MMLU (46\% of items have $d < 0.95$; Appendix~\ref{app:4pl_ablation}).
104	
105	\begin{table}[t]
106	\centering
107	\caption{Detection-diagnosis tradeoff on MMLU: Cohen's $|d|$ across three statistics. Qwen$^\dagger$: multi-seed means ($n{=}3$); Llama and Mistral: seed-42 single run with bootstrap CIs.}
108	\label{tab:degradation}
109	\footnotesize
110	\begin{tabular}{@{}llrr@{}}
111	\toprule
112	Model & Statistic & $|d|$ (15\%) & $|d|$ (50\%) \\
113	\midrule

115	     & HT & $5.83$ ($\pm$1.30) & $5.29$ ($\pm$3.41) \\
116	     & Acc.\ $z$ & $45.0$ ($\pm$2.5) & $70.0$ ($\pm$1.1) \\
117	\addlinespace
118	Llama & $\ell_z^*$ & $2.11$ [$1.4$, $4.8$] & $2.33$ [$1.6$, $5.1$] \\
119	      & HT & $2.45$ [$1.5$, $4.3$] & $3.07$ [$1.9$, $5.3$] \\
120	      & Acc.\ $z$ & $22.5$ [$13.6$, $47.0$] & $32.8$ [$19.8$, $68.6$] \\
121	\addlinespace
122	Mistral & $\ell_z^*$ & $2.64^{\ddagger}$ & $3.50$ [$2.1$, $9.4$] \\
123	      & HT & $4.36$ [$1.2$, $7.0$] & $5.89$ [$1.9$, $9.4$] \\

131	  \centering
132	  \includegraphics[width=\columnwidth]{fig_4_model_heatmap.pdf}
133	  \caption{$\ell_z^*$ heatmap for 12 leaderboard models across five benchmarks. 57/60 cells exceed $|\ell_z^*| > 1.96$, indicating pervasive IRT assumption violations even absent contamination. Details in Appendix~\ref{app:leaderboard_aberrance}.}
134	  \label{fig:leaderboard_heatmap}
135	\end{figure}
136	
137	\subsection{Ability-Dependent Non-Monotonic Dose-Response}
138	\label{sec:inverted_u}
139	
140	As an exploratory observation, the free-$\theta$ dose-response is non-monotonic for Qwen.
141	Figure~\ref{fig:composite}(d) plots the dose-response trajectory, combining the single-seed 5\% estimate (hollow marker) with multi-seed means at 15\%/25\%/50\% ($|d|$: $4.15 \to 5.36 \to 7.44 \to 5.08$), showing signal peaking at 25\% before declining; inter-seed variance at 50\% is high (CV${=}$60\%, range $[1.90, 7.91]$).
142	This non-monotonicity is a $\theta$-estimation artifact: fixed-$\theta$ eliminates the inverted-U ($|d|{=}12.32$ at 50\%, CV reduced to 19\%).
143	Llama's flat trajectory ($|d|{\approx}2.3$--$2.8$) is consistent with its near-zero baseline $\ell_z^*$.
144	Simulation corroborates these findings (${>}$93\% power at all levels; Appendix~\ref{app:simulation}).

17	# Paper Banana — 高品质学术概念图生成
18	
19	PaperBanana 由 Gemini Pro 自动写 matplotlib 代码，VLM Critic 评估渲染结果并迭代优化，输出顶会级别 300 DPI 概念图。
20	
21	**质量底线：每张图必须达到顶会论文的美观度——高级感、专业感、精致感。绝不接受 matplotlib 默认样式的廉价感。**
22	
23	## 适用范围
24	
25	| 场景 | 用什么 |
26	|------|--------|
27	| **概念图**（架构图、流程图、framework 示意） | **PaperBanana** ← 本 skill |
28	| **统计图**（scatter、bar、line、heatmap、forest） | **draw-paper-figure.skill.md**。**不要用 PaperBanana 画统计图** |
29	| 离线 / 无 GOOGLE_API_KEY | **draw-paper-figure.skill.md** |
30	
31	## 执行环境
32	
33	**PaperBanana 在本机（EC2）运行，不要 SSH 到远程服务器。**
34	
35	EC2（ap-northeast-1 东京）可直接访问 Gemini API，无需代理。
36	
37	## 前置条件
38	
39	### Step 1：获取 GOOGLE_API_KEY
40	
41	```python
42	request_secret(key_id="google_api_key", project="<project_name>", purpose="PaperBanana 概念图生成")
43	# 等待 Director 审批后
44	poll_secret_request(request_id="<返回的 request_id>", project="<project_name>")
45	```
46	
47	如果密钥尚未存储，告知 Director 需要 GOOGLE_API_KEY。
48	
49	### Step 2：安装验证（每次使用前必须检查）
50	
51	```bash
52	# 检查是否已安装
53	paperbanana --version 2>/dev/null || {
54	  echo "PaperBanana 未安装，正在安装..."
55	  pip install paperbanana -q
56	  paperbanana --version
57	}
58	```
59	
60	如果 `paperbanana --version` 失败（命令不存在），必须先 `pip install paperbanana -q` 安装。版本需 ≥ 0.1.2。
61	
62	**设计前必读** `skills/global/paper-visualization.skill.md` 的概念图 L1（防丑 7 条）+ L2（叙事 6 条）+ L3 Pattern + Checklist。统计图部分不适用于 PaperBanana。
63	
64	## 命令：generate
65	
66	概念图用 `generate` 子命令。**必须显式指定 `--vlm-model gemini-2.5-pro`**（默认模型 `gemini-2.0-flash` 已废弃，不指定会崩溃）。**`--iterations 5`**。
67	
68	## 完整流程
69	
70	### Step 1：写意图描述文件
71	
72	将详细设计描述写入文件（太长不适合命令行参数）：
73	
74	```bash
75	cat > /tmp/fig_intent.txt << 'INTENT'
76	Three-panel academic figure for a top-venue paper (full width, aspect ratio ~3.2:1, figsize 14x4.5 inches):
77	
78	Panel (a) 'The Phenomenon' (left, ~38% width):
79	Grouped bar chart. TF bars: dark navy (#2C3E50). AR bars: academic red (#C0392B).
80	Exact data: Base TF=0.501 AR=0.019, ThreadGate TF=0.504 AR=0.064, ...
81	Y-axis 'Mid-turn GAR' range 0–0.55. Only left+bottom spines. Serif font 10pt.
82	Add bracket annotation '8-17x gap' between bar groups.
83	
84	Panel (b) 'Diagnostic Chain' (center, ~24% width):
85	Vertical flowchart, 4 rounded boxes connected by thin gray arrows:
86	  Step 1: light gray (#F5F6F7) box, thin border (#DEE2E6), 'Gate Analysis' + subtitle. Green ✓
87	  Step 2: same style, 'PCGrad Exclusion'. Red ✗
88	  Step 3: same style, 'Representation Check'. Red ✗
89	  Step 4: light green (#D4EDDA) background, 'Conclusion: Exposure bias'. Green ✓
90	No axes, no spines. Clean infographic style.
91	
92	Panel (c) 'Constructive Evidence' (right, ~38% width):
93	Line plot. Data points: (0, 0.064), (3, 0.556), (5, 0.727).
94	Navy line (#2C3E50), open circles (white fill, navy edge, width 2).
95	Light blue fill (#EBF5FB, alpha 0.4) under curve.
96	Annotate '11x recovery' in muted gray, 9pt italic.
97	
98	OVERALL STYLE:
99	- 300 DPI, white background, publication quality
100	- Serif font (Times New Roman or similar) throughout
101	- Panel labels '(a)', '(b)', '(c)' in 11pt bold at top-left
102	- Generous white space (wspace=0.35)
103	- Muted academic palette: navy #2C3E50, red #C0392B, green #27AE60, gray #7F8C8D
104	- NO matplotlib default styling: no gray background, no thick gridlines, no tab10 colors
105	- Drop shadows on boxes: subtle, 2px offset, 10% opacity
106	- Rounded corners 8px on all rectangles
107	- Arrow heads: small, elegant, not bulky
108	INTENT
109	```
110	
111	### Step 2：运行 generate
112	
113	```bash
114	GOOGLE_API_KEY="[REDACTED]" paperbanana generate \
115	  --input /tmp/fig_intent.txt \
116	  --caption "Three-panel diagnostic framework: (a) TF vs AR performance gap, (b) systematic diagnosis chain, (c) beta-steering recovery evidence" \
117	  --vlm-model gemini-2.5-pro \
118	  --output figures/paper/fig1_overview.png \
119	  --iterations 5
120	```
121	
122	### Step 3：视觉检查（不可跳过）
123	
124	**Read 生成的 PNG 文件**，视觉评估以下维度：
125	
126	1. **高级感**：是否有顶会论文的精致感？还是看起来像课程作业？
127	2. **颜色**：是否有语义（不是随机分配）？是否和谐、不刺眼？
128	3. **文字**：缩到 column width 后是否 ≥ 7pt 可读？
129	4. **布局**：留白是否合理？元素是否对齐？
130	5. **细节**：圆角、阴影、箭头是否精致？边框是否统一？
131	
132	**不满意 → 必须修改意图描述文件，重新生成。**
133	
134	### Step 4：转 PDF
135	
136	```bash
137	python3 -c "
138	import matplotlib; matplotlib.use('Agg')
139	import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, matplotlib.image as mpimg
140	img = mpimg.imread('figures/paper/fig1_overview.png')
141	h, w = img.shape[:2]
142	fig = plt.figure(figsize=(w/300, h/300), dpi=300)
143	ax = fig.add_axes([0,0,1,1]); ax.imshow(img); ax.axis('off')
144	plt.savefig('figures/paper/fig1_overview.pdf', bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0)
145	plt.close()
146	"
147	```
148	
149	## 意图描述质量红线
150	
151	Intent 质量直接决定图的质量。必须包含以下 7 项（缺一不可）：
152	
153	1. **空间布局**：每个 panel 的宽度占比（如 38%/24%/38%）
154	2. **组件形状 + 尺寸**：圆角半径 8px、figsize (14, 4.5)
155	3. **颜色 hex 码**：不说"蓝色"，说 "#2C3E50"，绑定语义
156	4. **所有文字内容**：box label、副标题、箭头 annotation
157	5. **尺寸规格**：DPI 300、字号 10-12pt body / 8-9pt labels
158	6. **细节规格**：阴影偏移 2px / 10% opacity、箭头粗细、边框宽度
159	7. **反面约束**："NO matplotlib default styling, NO gray background, NO tab10 colors"
160	
161	### 美学风格关键词（必须在 intent 中出现）
162	
163	```
164	STYLE REQUIREMENTS:
165	- Publication quality for a TOP venue (NeurIPS/ICML/EMNLP)
166	- Elegant, premium, sophisticated — NOT cheap or homework-like
167	- Subtle drop shadows (2px, 10% opacity) on boxes
168	- Rounded corners (8px) on all rectangles
169	- Thin, elegant arrow heads — not bulky matplotlib defaults
170	- Serif font (Times) for labels, sans-serif (Helvetica) for annotations
171	- Muted, harmonious color palette — NO saturated primary colors
172	- Generous white space between elements
173	- Consistent visual weight across all panels
174	```
175	
176	### 反面教材（这样的 intent 一定画不好）
177	
178	- "Draw a pipeline diagram with three stages"
179	- "Architecture diagram for our system"
180	
181	太模糊。LLM 会用 matplotlib 默认样式填充所有你没指定的细节，结果就是廉价感。
182	
183	## 迭代策略（至少 3 轮外部迭代，Hero Figure 至少 5 轮）
184	
185	PaperBanana 内部有 VLM Critic 迭代（`--iterations 5`），但这还不够。你必须做**外部迭代**：
186	
187	### 第 1 轮：基础生成
188	运行 PaperBanana → Read PNG → 识别大方向问题（布局、配色、结构）
189	
190	### 第 2 轮：结构修复
191	修改意图描述（布局占比、颜色 hex、组件关系）→ 重新运行 → Read PNG
192	
193	### 第 3 轮：细节打磨
194	修改意图描述（字号、阴影、对齐、箭头粗细）→ 重新运行 → Read PNG
195	
196	### 第 4 轮（Hero Figure）：风格统一
197	线宽 / 字号 / 间距全图统一？与论文其他图配色一致？→ 重新运行 → Read PNG
198	
199	### 第 5 轮（Hero Figure）：最终 polish
200	像素级检查 → 缩到 column width 后文字 ≥ 7pt？→ 终极判断：放在 NeurIPS best paper 里违和吗？
201	
202	### 判断标准
203	
204	**可以交付**：看起来像 NeurIPS 2025 best paper 里的图。
205	**不可交付**：看起来像 matplotlib gallery 的示例图。
206	
207	## 失败回退
208	
209	如果 PaperBanana 多次崩溃（API 错误、模型不兼容）：
210	
211	1. 确认 `--vlm-model gemini-2.5-pro` 是否指定
212	2. 确认 GOOGLE_API_KEY 是否有效：`curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models?key=$GOOGLE_API_KEY"` 应返回 200
213	3. 如果仍然失败，回退 matplotlib 手写：
214	   - Read `skills/global/paper-visualization.skill.md` 获取 L1-L4 设计标准
215	   - 写 Python 脚本手动画概念图（FancyBboxPatch、FancyArrowPatch 等）
216	   - **同样必须 Read PNG 做视觉检查，至少迭代 3 轮**
217	   - **同样必须达到顶会级别的美观度**
218	   - 保存 .py 脚本到 figures/paper/ 目录便于后续修改

# Paper Banana — 高品质学术概念图生成

PaperBanana 由 Gemini Pro 自动写 matplotlib 代码，VLM Critic 评估渲染结果并迭代优化，输出顶会级别 300 DPI 概念图。

**质量底线：每张图必须达到顶会论文的美观度——高级感、专业感、精致感。绝不接受 matplotlib 默认样式的廉价感。**

## 适用范围

| 场景 | 用什么 |
|------|--------|
| **概念图**（架构图、流程图、framework 示意） | **PaperBanana** ← 本 skill |
| **统计图**（scatter、bar、line、heatmap、forest） | **draw-paper-figure.skill.md**。**不要用 PaperBanana 画统计图** |
| 离线 / 无 GOOGLE_API_KEY | **draw-paper-figure.skill.md** |

## 执行环境

**PaperBanana 在本机（EC2）运行，不要 SSH 到远程服务器。**

EC2（ap-northeast-1 东京）可直接访问 Gemini API，无需代理。

## 前置条件

### Step 1：获取 GOOGLE_API_KEY

```python
request_secret(key_id="google_api_key", project="<project_name>", purpose="PaperBanana 概念图生成")
# 等待 Director 审批后
poll_secret_request(request_id="<返回的 request_id>", project="<project_name>")
```

如果密钥尚未存储，告知 Director 需要 GOOGLE_API_KEY。

### Step 2：安装验证（每次使用前必须检查）

```bash
# 检查是否已安装
paperbanana --version 2>/dev/null || {
  echo "PaperBanana 未安装，正在安装..."
  pip install paperbanana -q
  paperbanana --version
}
```

如果 `paperbanana --version` 失败（命令不存在），必须先 `pip install paperbanana -q` 安装。版本需 ≥ 0.1.2。

**设计前必读** `skills/global/paper-visualization.skill.md` 的概念图 L1（防丑 7 条）+ L2（叙事 6 条）+ L3 Pattern + Checklist。统计图部分不适用于 PaperBanana。

## 命令：generate

概念图用 `generate` 子命令。**必须显式指定 `--vlm-model gemini-2.5-pro`**（默认模型 `gemini-2.0-flash` 已废弃，不指定会崩溃）。**`--iterations 5`**。

## 完整流程

### Step 1：写意图描述文件

将详细设计描述写入文件（太长不适合命令行参数）：

```bash
cat > /tmp/fig_intent.txt << 'INTENT'
Three-panel academic figure for a top-venue paper (full width, aspect ratio ~3.2:1, figsize 14x4.5 inches):

Panel (a) 'The Phenomenon' (left, ~38% width):
Grouped bar chart. TF bars: dark navy (#2C3E50). AR bars: academic red (#C0392B).
Exact data: Base TF=0.501 AR=0.019, ThreadGate TF=0.504 AR=0.064, ...
Y-axis 'Mid-turn GAR' range 0–0.55. Only left+bottom spines. Serif font 10pt.
Add bracket annotation '8-17x gap' between bar groups.

Panel (b) 'Diagnostic Chain' (center, ~24% width):
Vertical flowchart, 4 rounded boxes connected by thin gray arrows:
  Step 1: light gray (#F5F6F7) box, thin border (#DEE2E6), 'Gate Analysis' + subtitle. Green ✓
  Step 2: same style, 'PCGrad Exclusion'. Red ✗
  Step 3: same style, 'Representation Check'. Red ✗
  Step 4: light green (#D4EDDA) background, 'Conclusion: Exposure bias'. Green ✓
No axes, no spines. Clean infographic style.

Panel (c) 'Constructive Evidence' (right, ~38% width):
Line plot. Data points: (0, 0.064), (3, 0.556), (5, 0.727).
Navy line (#2C3E50), open circles (white fill, navy edge, width 2).
Light blue fill (#EBF5FB, alpha 0.4) under curve.
Annotate '11x recovery' in muted gray, 9pt italic.

OVERALL STYLE:
- 300 DPI, white background, publication quality
- Serif font (Times New Roman or similar) throughout
- Panel labels '(a)', '(b)', '(c)' in 11pt bold at top-left
- Generous white space (wspace=0.35)
- Muted academic palette: navy #2C3E50, red #C0392B, green #27AE60, gray #7F8C8D
- NO matplotlib default styling: no gray background, no thick gridlines, no tab10 colors
- Drop shadows on boxes: subtle, 2px offset, 10% opacity
- Rounded corners 8px on all rectangles
- Arrow heads: small, elegant, not bulky
INTENT
```

### Step 2：运行 generate

```bash
GOOGLE_API_KEY="[REDACTED]" paperbanana generate \
  --input /tmp/fig_intent.txt \
  --caption "Three-panel diagnostic framework: (a) TF vs AR performance gap, (b) systematic diagnosis chain, (c) beta-steering recovery evidence" \
  --vlm-model gemini-2.5-pro \
  --output figures/paper/fig1_overview.png \
  --iterations 5
```

### Step 3：视觉检查（不可跳过）

**Read 生成的 PNG 文件**，视觉评估以下维度：

1. **高级感**：是否有顶会论文的精致感？还是看起来像课程作业？
2. **颜色**：是否有语义（不是随机分配）？是否和谐、不刺眼？
3. **文字**：缩到 column width 后是否 ≥ 7pt 可读？
4. **布局**：留白是否合理？元素是否对齐？
5. **细节**：圆角、阴影、箭头是否精致？边框是否统一？

**不满意 → 必须修改意图描述文件，重新生成。**

### Step 4：转 PDF

```bash
python3 -c "
import matplotlib; matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, matplotlib.image as mpimg
img = mpimg.imread('figures/paper/fig1_overview.png')
h, w = img.shape[:2]
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(w/300, h/300), dpi=300)
ax = fig.add_axes([0,0,1,1]); ax.imshow(img); ax.axis('off')
plt.savefig('figures/paper/fig1_overview.pdf', bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0)
plt.close()
"
```

## 意图描述质量红线

Intent 质量直接决定图的质量。必须包含以下 7 项（缺一不可）：

1. **空间布局**：每个 panel 的宽度占比（如 38%/24%/38%）
2. **组件形状 + 尺寸**：圆角半径 8px、figsize (14, 4.5)
3. **颜色 hex 码**：不说"蓝色"，说 "#2C3E50"，绑定语义
4. **所有文字内容**：box label、副标题、箭头 annotation
5. **尺寸规格**：DPI 300、字号 10-12pt body / 8-9pt labels
6. **细节规格**：阴影偏移 2px / 10% opacity、箭头粗细、边框宽度
7. **反面约束**："NO matplotlib default styling, NO gray background, NO tab10 colors"

### 美学风格关键词（必须在 intent 中出现）

```
STYLE REQUIREMENTS:
- Publication quality for a TOP venue (NeurIPS/ICML/EMNLP)
- Elegant, premium, sophisticated — NOT cheap or homework-like
- Subtle drop shadows (2px, 10% opacity) on boxes
- Rounded corners (8px) on all rectangles
- Thin, elegant arrow heads — not bulky matplotlib defaults
- Serif font (Times) for labels, sans-serif (Helvetica) for annotations
- Muted, harmonious color palette — NO saturated primary colors
- Generous white space between elements
- Consistent visual weight across all panels
```

### 反面教材（这样的 intent 一定画不好）

- "Draw a pipeline diagram with three stages"
- "Architecture diagram for our system"

太模糊。LLM 会用 matplotlib 默认样式填充所有你没指定的细节，结果就是廉价感。

## 迭代策略（至少 3 轮外部迭代，Hero Figure 至少 5 轮）

PaperBanana 内部有 VLM Critic 迭代（`--iterations 5`），但这还不够。你必须做**外部迭代**：

### 第 1 轮：基础生成
运行 PaperBanana → Read PNG → 识别大方向问题（布局、配色、结构）

### 第 2 轮：结构修复
修改意图描述（布局占比、颜色 hex、组件关系）→ 重新运行 → Read PNG

### 第 3 轮：细节打磨
修改意图描述（字号、阴影、对齐、箭头粗细）→ 重新运行 → Read PNG

### 第 4 轮（Hero Figure）：风格统一
线宽 / 字号 / 间距全图统一？与论文其他图配色一致？→ 重新运行 → Read PNG

### 第 5 轮（Hero Figure）：最终 polish
像素级检查 → 缩到 column width 后文字 ≥ 7pt？→ 终极判断：放在 NeurIPS best paper 里违和吗？

### 判断标准

**可以交付**：看起来像 NeurIPS 2025 best paper 里的图。
**不可交付**：看起来像 matplotlib gallery 的示例图。

## 失败回退

如果 PaperBanana 多次崩溃（API 错误、模型不兼容）：

1. 确认 `--vlm-model gemini-2.5-pro` 是否指定
2. 确认 GOOGLE_API_KEY 是否有效：`curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models?key=$GOOGLE_API_KEY"` 应返回 200
3. 如果仍然失败，回退 matplotlib 手写：
   - Read `skills/global/paper-visualization.skill.md` 获取 L1-L4 设计标准
   - 写 Python 脚本手动画概念图（FancyBboxPatch、FancyArrowPatch 等）
   - **同样必须 Read PNG 做视觉检查，至少迭代 3 轮**
   - **同样必须达到顶会级别的美观度**
   - 保存 .py 脚本到 figures/paper/ 目录便于后续修改

\section{Simulation Validation}
\label{app:simulation}

Under the null (no contamination), bootstrap $\ell_z^*$ tracks $\mathcal{N}(0,1)$: mean bias 0.041 and standard deviation 1.003 on MMLU.
Kolmogorov--Smirnov rejection rates vary with benchmark size: 8.3\% for MMLU and HellaSwag ($n > 10{,}000$), 50.0\% for GSM8K ($n = 1{,}319$), 58.3\% for ARC-C ($n = 295$), and 75.0\% for HumanEval ($n = 164$).
$\ell_z^*$ is well-calibrated for benchmarks with $n \geq 10{,}000$ items; smaller benchmarks show increasing finite-sample deviations from normality.

Two-sided testing eliminates the inverted-U artifact: MMLU achieves 97.8\% power at 15\% contamination and sustains ${>}$93\% at all levels.
Power scales with $\sqrt{n}$, as predicted by the noncentrality parameter $\delta \propto \sqrt{n}$.
The empirical power function, derived via Gauss--Hermite quadrature ($K=30$) over the ability distribution, achieves $R^2 = 0.957$ against simulated values, with approximate minimum benchmark size of $n \geq 7{,}958$ items for 80\% power at 15\% contamination under MMLU item parameters.

\section{4PL vs.\ 3PL Ablation Details}
\label{app:4pl_ablation}

Table~\ref{tab:4pl_3pl_power} reports detection power (proportion of 2{,}000 simulation replicates rejecting $H_0$ at $\alpha{=}0.05$, two-sided) for 4PL and 3PL parameterizations across five benchmarks and seven contamination levels.
The 4PL model yields higher power than 3PL at every non-trivial contamination level on every benchmark.
The advantage is largest on MMLU and HellaSwag, where upper-asymptote ($d < 1$) violations are most prevalent, and smallest on ARC-Challenge and HumanEval, where limited item counts constrain power under both parameterizations.

Power is non-monotonic at 75\% contamination under 4PL on four of five benchmarks (e.g., MMLU: $.952 \to .938$; GSM8K: $.846 \to .802$).
This reflects the $\theta$-shift boundary condition described in \S\ref{sec:inverted_u}: at high contamination fractions, re-estimated $\hat{\theta}$ absorbs part of the aberrance signal, reducing $|\ell_z^*|$.
At 100\% contamination, all items are seen and power reaches 1.000 trivially.
The 4PL advantage over 3PL depends on accurate estimation of the upper asymptote $d$; with estimation error exceeding ${\sim}10\%$, the effective model behavior approaches 3PL ($d{=}1$) and the power gain diminishes.
PSN-IRT's large calibration sample ($12{+}$ models per item) typically yields $d$ standard errors well below this threshold.

{\raggedright\scriptsize $^{a}$\citet{wang2025fragility}: 10 methods fail post-RL.
$^{b}$Structurally invariant; empirical verification future work.\par}
\end{table}

Contamination detection methods vary in what information they require from the model under test.
Table~\ref{tab:frontier} organizes the detection frontier by information access, from most to least demanding.
At the high end, corpus-search methods match benchmark items against pretraining data \citep{dodge2021, magar2022}, but require full corpus access, which is unavailable for closed models.
Membership inference attacks (MIA) use token-level log-probabilities to distinguish training examples from unseen ones \citep{minkprob2024, deng2024}.
Generation-based probes elicit benchmark content via prompting \citep{golchin2024, oren2024}.
Performance-based methods such as ConStat \citep{constat2024} and CoDeC \citep{codec2026} compare a model's accuracy on the target benchmark against accuracy on perturbed or reference sets, requiring either multiple evaluations or in-context learning passes.
\citet{sainz2023} propose overlapping-split analysis using time-stamped data.

A critical limitation unites all log-probability methods: \citet{wang2025fragility} demonstrate that reinforcement learning (RL) post-training renders MIA-based detectors (including Min-K\%++) no better than random across 10 methods and 4 benchmarks.
RL reshapes token-level output distributions while largely preserving binary correctness patterns, so token-level statistics lose signal while binary response patterns remain available for analysis.
\citet{selfcritique2026} and \citet{zhang2026rlvr} propose RL-specific solutions but require generation-level access.

\irtfit{} operates at the bottom of this frontier: it requires only binary responses (correct/incorrect), making it applicable to any model accessible through a standard evaluation API.
Recent work applies IRT to LLM evaluation for ability estimation \citep{martinezplumed2019, polo2024tinybenchmarks}, adaptive testing \citep{atlas2025}, and benchmark diagnostics \citep{psnirt2026}, but none use \emph{person-fit} statistics for contamination detection.
Our work bridges this gap.

\section{Discussion}\label{sec:discussion}

\paragraph{Detection vs.\ diagnosis.}
The detection-diagnosis tradeoff reveals a design tension absent from prior contamination detection work.
Simpler statistics---accuracy $z$-scores, HT---detect contamination more powerfully because they are not attenuated by the Snijders correction or inflated by $\theta$-shift absorption.
Yet $\ell_z^*$ provides unique mechanistic insight invisible to non-IRT statistics: $\theta$-shift analysis reveals \emph{why} detection varies across models (baseline ability determines absorption magnitude), seen/unseen decomposition localizes the signal source, and 4PL modeling captures ceiling effects that 3PL misses ($+$27.3pp power on MMLU).
Our contribution lies not in proposing a new detection method but in quantifying these theoretically predicted phenomena where magnitudes are not derivable from IRT theory alone.

\paragraph{Practical implications.}
For practitioners, we recommend a two-stage workflow: (i)~screen with accuracy $z$-scores, which require no item parameters and produce the largest effect sizes; (ii)~characterize flagged models with $\ell_z^*$ to determine whether the signal reflects $\theta$-shift absorption (high-ability model, large $\Delta\theta$) or direct memorization (anomalous successes on hard items without commensurate $\theta$ inflation).
$\theta$-anchoring is necessary to stabilize detection for high-ability models (free-$\theta$ CV up to 60\% vs.\ 19\% under $\theta$-fixed; \S\ref{sec:theta_dynamics}).
$\ell_z^*$ is most informative for large benchmarks: simulation yields $n \approx 8{,}000$ items for 80\% power at 15\% contamination (Appendix~\ref{app:simulation}), making MMLU ($n{=}14{,}042$) well-powered but ARC-C ($n{=}295$) marginal under low contamination.
Universal baseline misfit (57/60 cells flagged; Figure~\ref{fig:leaderboard_heatmap}) means absolute $\ell_z^*$ thresholds cannot be used directly; the $\Delta\ell_z^*$ matched-difference design or cross-benchmark comparison is required.

\paragraph{Robustness and complementarity.}
PSN-IRT provides pre-calibrated 4PL parameters \citep{psnirt2026} that are robust to estimation noise: $\pm$10\% parameter perturbation produces $<$4\% bias in fixed-$\theta$ Cohen's $d$ (Appendix~\ref{app:param_perturb}), because the matched-difference design cancels shared parameter error.
Requiring only binary response patterns and an external item bank, $\ell_z^*$ occupies a unique position in the detection frontier (Table~\ref{tab:frontier}): it complements logit-based methods \citep{minkprob2024,constat2024} that fail after RL post-training \citep{wang2025fragility}.
Our GRPO pilot illustrates this complementarity: Min-K\% AUC drops to chance ($0.493$) after 500 RL steps, while the $\ell_z^*$ response-pattern gap persists at ${\sim}3.3$ across all checkpoints (Figure~\ref{fig:grpo}).
This structural invariance---RL reshapes token-level distributions but preserves binary correctness anomalies---suggests that person-fit statistics may remain informative in settings where all probability-based detectors fail, though this $N{=}1$ observation requires multi-family validation.

\subsection{Experimental Setup}
\label{sec:setup}

\paragraph{Models and contamination.}
We validate on three 7--8B model families: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, and Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3.
Each is fine-tuned with Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA; rank\,$=$\,16, $\alpha$\,$=$\,32; full hyperparameters in Appendix~\ref{app:hyperparams}) under clean and contaminated conditions at varying levels: at $X\%$ contamination, $X\%$ of SFT training examples are benchmark items (questions paired with gold answers in the standard evaluation format), with the remainder drawn from a general instruction-following dataset.
All three families are tested at 15\% and 50\% contamination.
Following initial observation of non-monotonic dose-response for Qwen, we added 5\% and 25\% conditions for Qwen to trace the full dose-response curve.
Both conditions were subsequently extended to Llama to test whether the pattern generalizes; Mistral was additionally tested at 5\% but not at 25\% due to computational constraints.
We train $n{=}10$ independent clean seeds per model to establish baseline variability and construct bootstrap confidence intervals.
Reported CIs reflect variability across $n$ clean baseline seeds; for each model family, selected contamination levels were additionally replicated with $n{=}3$ independent QLoRA seeds to assess training-run variance: Qwen at 15\%/25\%/50\%, Llama at 5\%/15\%/25\%/50\%, and Mistral at 5\%/15\%/50\% (Appendix~\ref{app:reproducibility}).

\paragraph{Benchmarks.}
We evaluate on MMLU \citep{hendrycks2021mmlu} (14,042 items) and ARC-Challenge \citep{clark2018arc} (295 items), spanning two orders of magnitude in benchmark size.
All 4PL item parameters are from \citet{psnirt2026}.
ARC-Challenge experiments were conducted on Qwen only, as the primary evaluation of cross-benchmark generalizability; extending to additional families was constrained by computational budget.

\paragraph{Post-RL extension.}
To probe behavior boundaries beyond SFT, we apply Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO; \citealp{shao2024}) to one contaminated Qwen model (15\% MMLU) for 1,500 steps, evaluating at three checkpoints.
This extension is $N{=}1$ (single model family, single contamination level).

\paragraph{Contamination model.}
QLoRA SFT on benchmark items proxies SFT-stage contamination, analogous to a test-taker with item preknowledge.
We term contaminated items \emph{seen} and the remainder \emph{unseen}, enabling person-fit decomposition (\S\ref{sec:degradation}).
Findings are scoped to SFT-based contamination.

b_param = items['b_difficulty'].values
c_param = items['c_guessing'].values
d_param = items['d_feasibility'].values

theta = 0.5
p_irt = c_param + (d_param - c_param) / (1 + np.exp(-a_param * (theta - b_param)))
p_clip = np.clip(p_irt, 1e-10, 1 - 1e-10)

clean = (np.random.random(N) < p_irt).astype(int)

np.random.seed(42)

def lz_star(resp, a, b, c, d, th):
    pr = np.clip(c + (d - c) / (1 + np.exp(-a * (th - b))), 1e-10, 1 - 1e-10)
    ll = np.sum(resp * np.log(pr) + (1 - resp) * np.log(1 - pr))
    mu = np.sum(pr * np.log(pr) + (1 - pr) * np.log(1 - pr))
